description: Games are a very good training ground for agents. Think about it. Perfectly packaged, neatly constrained environments where agents can run wild, work out the rules for themselves, and learn how to handle autonomy. In this episode, Research Engineering Team Lead, Frederic Besse, joins Hannah as they discuss important research like SIMA (Scalable Instructable Multiworld Agent) and what we can expect from future agents that can understand and safely carry out a wide range of tasks - online and in t…
classificationReason: Directly addresses agents learning in interactive environments and carrying out tasks in the real world, including SIMA research.
qualityReason: Focused research interview discussing named systems, training environments, autonomy, and safety.
